title: Independent review of the previously published ADFGVX challenge readings
scope: Fourteen challenge entries with earlier full or partial body readings. Earlier discoveries remain credited to their first identified public sources; source corrections and arithmetic review are the present contribution.

conventions.offsets: All positions are zero based, half-open [start, end) intervals, measured in the named source stage before edits.
conventions.source_layer: analysis_ciphertext masks non-ADFGVX glyphs and preserves the source catalog's explicit layout assumptions; raw_source_grouped retains literal source notation.
conventions.ciphertext_edits: Applied simultaneously at the received-coordinate stage, in source order.
conventions.intermediate_edits: Applied after inverse columnar transposition and before Polybius pairing. Used only for the explicit p132 sender-error hypothesis.
conventions.question_mark: Unresolved coordinate, unresolved plaintext, or unassigned square cell; never a freely invented recovered character.
conventions.domains: Per-position possible characters under directly attested square cells. Unassigned cells globally form a bijection with the missing symbols; per-position sets do not remove that coupling.
conventions.historical_claims: Language normalization and contextual completion are labeled separately from exact raw decryption.
conventions.reencryption: An ordinary complete roundtrip is certified only for a fully determined even intermediate stream with no sender-stage edits. Odd suffixes and p132's extra coordinate are retained explicitly.
